page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors. It features 64 virtual CPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a distinct contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests falling into the bottom 25%. However, multi-core execution scales effectively, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Notably, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performs in the top 25%, demonstrating strong parallel processing efficiency. Memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput both register in the average tier.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.ic5.16xlarge is its highly skewed resource allocation, offering massive parallel compute capacity but very limited memory per core. This makes it a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. It is well-suited for highly parallelizable tasks such as multi-threaded decompression, batch processing, and moderate web serving, but is poorly suited for memory-intensive databases or single-threaded applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.16xlarge is an x86_64 compute-focused server featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of RAM. Lacking local storage and GPUs, this KVM-hypervised instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. Benchmarks reveal weak single-core performance but average multi-core capabilities, highlighted by strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. With a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.0 GB per core, this server is highly optimized for parallelized, compute-intensive tasks that do not demand large memory footprints, such as batch processing, multi-threaded compilation, and distributed web serving.
